keyPhrases.text: almost guaranteed to have a good time
exhilarating and a joy to watch

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic recommendation ('grab your significant other and go'). Praises performances extensively with superlatives like 'powerhouse,' 'incredible cast,' and 'tour de force.' Director and choreography also highly praised. Only minor concern is acknowledgment it 'may not be for everyone' due to subject matter, but reviewer frames this as reason everyone should see it. Clear 4/5 star review with strong recommendation.
